# redis_kv_* command encodings (redis-gateway-module task 1).
# Regenerate with KYTHIRA_UPDATE_GOLDENS=1; a change here is a log-entry
# format change.
command set plain
  01010000000c736363616368652f6f626a3100000000000000000000000c6f62
  6a6563742d6279746573
  key=sccache/obj1
command set with expiry
  01010000000c736363616368652f6f626a32000001b8dac5b4000000000176
  key=sccache/obj2
command set binary value
  01010000000b736363616368652f62696e000000000000000000000006610d0a
  0062ff
  key=sccache/bin
command set empty key and value
  010100000000000000000000000000000000
  key=
command del
  01020000000c736363616368652f6f626a31
  key=sccache/obj1
command del empty key
  010200000000
  key=
command sweep none
  01030000000000000000
  key=
command sweep two
  010300000000000000020000000c736363616368652f6f626a32000001b8dac5
  b4000000000c736363616368652f6f626a33000001b8dac5b401
  key=sccache/obj2

  key=sccache/obj1

  key=a
